slides.headline: SAVE THIS: ALL FOUR MAJOR AIS CRASHED AT THE SAME TIME
slides.body: • ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok all went down simultaneously • September 3, 3:28 PM • Four rival companies, zero backups Send this to the friend who thinks having one AI app is enough

caption:
ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok all crashed at the same moment yesterday. Swipe to see why switching apps got no one anywhere. 🔴

Why everyone assumed rival AIs were safe backups for each other, the app-switching moment when every option failed one by one, the simultaneous reveal that all four went dark together, the irony of four competing companies failing at once, what this means if your business runs on these tools, the full story as a checklist.

Four separate companies, four separate systems. On September 3, 2026, they all went dark at the exact same moment. No warning, no backup, nowhere to turn. This is what AI dependency without a redundancy plan looks like.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this means for yours.

Sources: Watcher.Guru on X, September 3, 2026
